<function name="GetFlexBounds" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns acceptable value range for the flex controller, as defined by the model.

Used with <page>Entity:SetFlexWeight</page>.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="flex" type="number">The ID of the flex to look up bounds of</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">The minimum value for this flex</ret>
		<ret name="" type="number">The maximum value for this flex</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
